Pareto AttuneBench

cohort4.benchmark.attunebench

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

Actual primary main-method/results/limits and complete creator-documentation reads establish one AttuneBench benchmark family:200conversations collected from11selected US native-English adult participants, own first-person preferences/affect annotations and explicit evaluation/metric protocol. The11evaluatedmodels are distinct from the11humanparticipants;200conversations are not200independent people. Human labels are subjective participant ground truth, optionaldraftjudge is a singleLLM metric, and pooledconversation significance does not establish population independence or clinical safety. Exact originalqualifiedsubjectfacts retain their3realcurrentdigestreviews, wording and limits; no experiment/statistical reproduction or new scientific pass. Full_source means the available primary family protocol/identity/evaluation/rights/limits documentation read here, not participant-data audit or unread appendices. MITcode and separatelyCCBY4.0data scope retained; no clinical/IRB/HIPAA/absence-of-PII guarantee independently certified.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Pareto AttuneBench · documents: The primary scoring composite weights emotion tracking 24%, evaluation quality 49% and holistic comprehension 27%; Kendall tau and draft quality judging are supplementary rather than composite inputs.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.attunebench.composite-and-judge-scope

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Default, Verbose and profile-informed Omniscient contexts differ. An LLM draft judge is not objective emotional intelligence or a clinical outcome measure.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Pareto AttuneBench · documents: The paper documents informed consent, withdrawal, topic reassignment and manual PII redaction, while explicitly excluding clinical mental-health validation and safety-critical deployment conclusions.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.attunebench.ethics-and-generalization

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • The small, text-only US/native-English participant pool and selective/self-reported disclosures limit generalization. A three-annotator seven-conversation baseline is a pilot, not a full human ceiling.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Pareto AttuneBench · documents: Participants had at least five exchanges with an anonymized original model, completed PANAS/binary labels, compared original and preference-informed model responses, and drafted human-edited golden responses.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Pareto AttuneBench · documents: AttuneBench’s 200 conversations were collected from eleven US-based native-English-speaking adults, with each participant annotating their own emotional states, observed/preferred behavior and response preferences.

Permanent record ID: candidate.mandatory19.cohort4.benchmark.attunebench.participant-and-task.units

  • Source-version-bound creator disclosure; private author-only candidate, with no approved scientific independence, new family coverage or supplier-relationship credit.
  • Conversations and 50,000-plus annotations are not separate people. Participation is imbalanced and demographic/diagnostic information is self-reported.
